parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Allowed: id, name, email, total_price, created_at, shopify_created_at, shopify_updated_at, shopify_processed_at, financial_status, fulfillment_status, legacy_resource_id, currency, shopify_cancelled_at, billing_name, shipping_name, payment_gateway, sales_order, shipping_method

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Search across order name, email, Shopify ID, SKU SO#, SKU line items, shipping method

parameters.name: filter[financial_status]
parameters.description: Exact match: pending, authorized, partially_paid, paid, partially_refunded, refunded, voided

parameters.name: filter[fulfillment_status]
parameters.description: Exact match: fulfilled, null, partial, restocked

parameters.name: filter[has_sku_order]
parameters.description: true = has linked SKU sales order, false = no SKU order

parameters.name: filter[cancelled]
parameters.description: true = cancelled orders only, false = exclude cancelled

parameters.name: filter[name.contains]
parameters.description: Advanced text filter on order name

parameters.name: search_columns
parameters.description: Comma-separated columns for targeted search (name, email, legacy_resource_id, etc.)
